BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to health departments; and adding a new section tochapter 70.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A local board of health operating under this chapter must includethe mayor of the participating city and the county executive of theparticipating county. The mayor and the county executive shallalternately serve as chair of the local board of health.
